title: Panasonic Toaster Oven Sold at Costco and Amazon Recalled Over Shock and Fire Risk

body:
Panasonic has issued a recall for its Model No. NB-G200 Electric Toaster Oven across the United States and Canada after determining that the appliance poses a risk of electric shock and fire. Shoppers who purchased the toaster oven at Costco, on Amazon, or through other retailers are urged to stop using it immediately.

For many Indian diaspora families in the US and Canada, kitchen appliances like toaster ovens are staples for preparing a variety of dishes, from quick breakfasts to elaborate meals. This recall highlights the importance of staying informed about product safety, especially for those who may have purchased these items for their homes or as gifts for relatives.

What's Being Recalled

> "This recall highlights the importance of staying informed about product safety, especially for those who may have purchased these items for their homes or as gifts for relatives."

The recall covers approximately 11,480 units sold in the US and 2,184 in Canada. According to Panasonic, the power cord insulation "can be insufficient due to a protective fiberglass sleeve not covering it adequately, posing a risk of shock and/or fire hazard." The toaster oven was sold between October 2022 and April 2024 at approximately $170.

Reports Filed So Far

The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) has received four reports of the toaster oven tripping circuit breakers or outlets. A fifth report noted the appliance stopped working. Fortunately, no injuries have been reported in connection with these incidents.

What To Do

Both the CPSC and Health Canada urge consumers to stop using the recalled toaster oven and contact Panasonic for a full refund. This is particularly relevant for Indian diaspora members who might have purchased this appliance, as ensuring household safety is a priority, especially in homes with children or elderly family members.

Costco members also have the option to return the product to any warehouse for a full refund. This recall adds to a growing list of kitchen appliance safety actions, including previously recalled sauté pans, space heaters, and electric kettles sold at major retailers. Consumers are encouraged to regularly check for product recalls to ensure the safety of their homes and families.
